cl.p1: In March I spent two weeks on work experience in your workshop. On the last day I was allowed to do an oil change on my own under supervision, and Mr Shaw told me I should apply. So I am.
cl.p2: I take my GCSEs in summer 2027 and my best subjects are Engineering and Maths. At home I work on my uncle’s old moped – most recently we cleaned and re-tuned the carburettor.
cl.p3: I also have a Saturday job, so I know what it means to be on time and to get stuck in. I can come in for a chat any afternoon after school.
